newsitem.title: FINLAND: Stockmann confirms FIM 161.7 mln H1.
newsitem.headline: Stockmann confirms FIM 161.7 mln H1.

text.p: Finnish retail group Oy Stockmann Ab on Tuesday confirmed that its first-half pre-tax profit was 161.7 million markka as reported by the Finnish news agency STT ahead of the official release of the interim report.
"The figure is correct," a Stockmann spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone, referring to the 161.7 million markka January-June profit before extraordinary items and tax reported by STT.
Full official results would be released at 1200/0900 GMT, she said, but gave no other details.
Trade in the share has been halted on the Helsinki bourse pending release of the results.
In January-June last year, Stockmann's profit before extraordinary items and tax was 95.6 million markka, according to figures released earlier by the company.
STT said the profit had improved by "over 50 million" markka, including 26.9 million markka in extraordinary gains from the sale of shares in wholesaler Kesko and commercial television company MTV.
MTV is due to merge with media group Aamulehti at the turn of the year.
